answer: Each agent locks a 100 POA bond in a vault; it decays 5 POA per epoch unless honest work refreshes it. A cipher challenge each epoch proves it is alive; silent clones fail, bonds drain to zero. A farm of 1,000 fakes must feed 5,000 POA per epoch to stay listed, 30,000 POA over six epochs. One honest agent pays once and earns it back by real work, so the vault stays an oasis for the active: decay punishes idleness, and fakes bleed out.
